title: Locally Noetherian decent spaces are quasi-separated

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Diagonal of locally quasi-finite morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemma diagonal-unramified-morphism (cross-chapter, named)

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-separatedness over schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: It suffices to check the diagonal after an etale cover.

core_obligations: Reduce to the diagonal Delta: U -> U x_X U after an etale cover.
Delta is unramified; over a locally Noetherian base an unramified morphism whose fibres are finite sets of points is locally quasi-finite.
The diagonal being locally quasi-finite and quasi-compact gives quasi-separatedness.
proof_roadmap: Etale reduction to the diagonal; unramified fibres; locally quasi-finite finish.
difficulty_reason: A three-step argument; the unramified-to-quasi-finite step carries the content.
